name: shown by its creations
headline: Shown by its *creations*
visualData: The business card — your card and your links · one entry in your index
Websites and games — published straight from tiles
The language — translated by its community into fourteen tongues
Communities — meetups and gathering places, in hives
say: Here is the pattern, shown through what people make with it. The business card: your card and your links, passed on with a scan, with nothing to sign up for, and one entry in your index. Websites and games, published straight from tiles. The language itself, translated by its community into fourteen tongues. And real communities, gathering in hives: meetups, study groups, and centres where people belong. Each one is the same simple pattern, in a different shape.
